% A memoir document with a list of its own from memoir's \newlistof, and
% ntheorem's \listtheorems, beside the stale list files of an earlier
% build: test-staleaux-toc-memoir.exa, from a PDF build without hyperref,
% has three-argument \contentsline lines, which tex4ht's four-argument
% \contentsline reads past the end of the file, and
% test-staleaux-toc-memoir.thm, from a build that loaded xcolor, has an
% entry with \textcolor. Their old entries are not in the page, and the
% stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{memoir}
\usepackage{ntheorem}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newlistof{listofexamples}{exa}{List of Examples}
\newcounter{example}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exa}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexamples
\section*{Theorems}
\listtheorems{theorem}
\chapter{First}
Text of the first chapter.
\example{A new example}
\begin{theorem}[New theorem]
The statement of the theorem.
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
